### Set Up for Importing

All our csv files need to ensure standardised column names to avoid errors when importing - this is done using R so we gather all our csv files

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

csv_dir <- "."

csv_files <- c(
  bespoke_task_mp_bridge = "bespoke_task_mp_bridge.csv",
  bespoke_task_table     = "bespoke_task_table.csv",
  disease_clean          = "disease_clean.csv",
  genotype_bridge        = "genotype_bridge.csv",
  IMPC_parameters        = "IMPC_parameters.csv",
  mouse_merged           = "mouse_merged.csv",
  procedures             = "procedures.csv"
)
```

# 1. Print the exact column names of each CSV

```{r}
col_list <- lapply(file.path(csv_dir, csv_files), function(p) {
  names(read_csv(p, n_max = 0, show_col_types = FALSE))
})
names(col_list) <- names(csv_files)
col_list

```

# 2. Build a cross-table map showing which columns appear in which CSVs

```{r}
col_audit <- bind_rows(lapply(names(col_list), function(tbl) {
  data.frame(table = tbl, column = col_list[[tbl]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})) %>%
  group_by(column) %>%
  summarise(
    n_tables = n(),
    tables = paste(table, collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_tables), column)

print(col_audit, n = 100)

csv_dir <- "."
out_dir <- "standardised_csvs"

if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

# Renaming all our tables

```{r}
# 1. bespoke_task_mp_bridge
bespoke_task_mp_bridge_std <- read_csv(file.path(csv_dir, "bespoke_task_mp_bridge.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(
    bespoke_row_id = task_row_id,
    mp_term_id     = mp_id
  )

# 2. bespoke_task_table
bespoke_task_table_std <- read_csv(file.path(csv_dir, "bespoke_task_table.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(
    bespoke_row_id = task_row_id,
    mgi_gene_id    = mgi_id
  ) %>%
  select(bespoke_row_id, human_gene_symbol, human_ncbi_gene_id, mouse_gene_symbol, mgi_gene_id)

# 3. disease_clean (drop unsplit mouse_genotype_ids now that genotype_bridge holds them)
disease_clean_std <- read_csv(file.path(csv_dir, "disease_clean.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(
    disease_row_id = row_id,
    mgi_gene_id    = mgi_id
  ) %>%
  select(
    disease_row_id,
    human_gene_symbol,
    human_gene_name,
    hgnc_id,
    disease_name,
    doid,
    mouse_gene_symbol,
    mgi_gene_id
  )

# 4. genotype_bridge
genotype_bridge_std <- read_csv(file.path(csv_dir, "genotype_bridge.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(disease_row_id = row_id) %>%
  select(disease_row_id, mouse_genotype_id)

# 5. IMPC_parameters
impc_parameters_std <- read_csv(file.path(csv_dir, "IMPC_parameters.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(
    impc_parameter_orig_id = impcParameterOrigId,
    parameter_stable_id    = parameterId,
    parameter_name         = name,
    parameter_description    = description
  ) %>%
  select(impc_parameter_orig_id, parameter_stable_id, parameter_name, parameter_description)

# 6. mouse_merged
mouse_merged_std <- read_csv(file.path(csv_dir, "mouse_merged.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(
    mgi_gene_id         = gene_accession_id,
    mouse_gene_symbol   = gene_symbol,
    parameter_stable_id = parameter_id
  )

# 7. procedures
procedures_std <- read_csv(file.path(csv_dir, "procedures.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(
    impc_parameter_orig_id = impcParameterOrigId,
    procedure_name         = name,
    procedure_description    = description,
    is_mandatory           = isMandatory
  ) %>%
  select(impc_parameter_orig_id, procedure_name, procedure_description, is_mandatory)
```

# Save standardised CSVs

```{r}
std_tables <- list(
  bespoke_task_mp_bridge = bespoke_task_mp_bridge_std,
  bespoke_task_table     = bespoke_task_table_std,
  disease_clean          = disease_clean_std,
  genotype_bridge        = genotype_bridge_std,
  IMPC_parameters        = impc_parameters_std,
  mouse_merged           = mouse_merged_std,
  procedures             = procedures_std
)

for (nm in names(std_tables)) {
  write_csv(std_tables[[nm]], file.path(out_dir, paste0(nm, ".csv")), na = "")
}
```

# Check the column names 

And lets also check which column names are in what tables and how many tables

```{r}
std_cols <- bind_rows(lapply(names(std_tables), function(tbl) {
  data.frame(table = tbl, column = names(std_tables[[tbl]]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})) %>%
  group_by(column) %>%
  summarise(
    n_tables = n(),
    tables = paste(table, collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_tables > 1) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_tables), column)

print(std_cols, n = 50)


intersect(
  c("mgi_gene_id", "mouse_gene_symbol", "parameter_stable_id", "parameter_name"),
  names(mouse_merged_std)
)

```

# Add chromsome 2 to our folder

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

chrom2_std <- chrom2 %>%
  rename(
    ensembl_gene_id       = `Gene.stable.ID`,
    ensembl_transcript_id = `Transcript.stable.ID`,
    gene_name             = `Gene.name`,
    ensembl_exon_id       = `Exon.stable.ID`,
    exon_start            = `Exon.region.start..bp.`,
    exon_end              = `Exon.region.end..bp.`,
    exon_rank             = `Exon.rank.in.transcript`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(ensembl_gene_id, ensembl_transcript_id, gene_name, ensembl_exon_id),
      ~ trimws(as.character(.x))
    ),
    exon_start = as.numeric(exon_start),
    exon_end   = as.numeric(exon_end),
    exon_rank  = as.integer(exon_rank)
  )

# Verify exact column names
names(chrom2_std)

out_dir <- "standardised_csvs"
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

write_csv(chrom2_std, file.path(out_dir, "chrom2.csv"), na = "")

names(chrom2_std)
```

### Standardisation is now complete lets begin to import into SQL

# Create the SQL Schema

```{sql connection=}

CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS data_base_merged
  CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

USE data_base_merged;

-- 1. Mouse MGI reference (union across datasets).
CREATE TABLE mouse_gene (
    mgi_gene_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    mouse_gene_symbol VARCHAR(128),
    PRIMARY KEY (mgi_gene_id),
    INDEX idx_mouse_gene_symbol (mouse_gene_symbol)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 2. Human gene reference.
CREATE TABLE human_gene (
    human_gene_id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    human_gene_symbol VARCHAR(128),
    human_gene_name VARCHAR(255),
    human_ncbi_gene_id VARCHAR(64),
    hgnc_id VARCHAR(64),
    PRIMARY KEY (human_gene_id),
    UNIQUE KEY uq_human_ncbi_gene_id (human_ncbi_gene_id),
    UNIQUE KEY uq_human_hgnc_id (hgnc_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 3. Procedure catalogue.
CREATE TABLE procedures (
    procedure_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    impc_parameter_orig_id BIGINT,
    procedure_name VARCHAR(255),
    procedure_description TEXT,
    is_mandatory TINYINT(1),
    PRIMARY KEY (procedure_code),
    INDEX idx_proc_orig_id (impc_parameter_orig_id),
    CONSTRAINT chk_proc_mandatory CHECK (is_mandatory IS NULL OR is_mandatory IN (0, 1))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 4. Parameter metadata.
CREATE TABLE IMPC_parameters (
    parameter_stable_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    parameter_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    parameter_description TEXT,
    procedure_code VARCHAR(32),
    impc_parameter_orig_id BIGINT,
    PRIMARY KEY (parameter_stable_id),
    INDEX idx_param_proc_code (procedure_code),
    INDEX idx_param_orig_id (impc_parameter_orig_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_param_procedure FOREIGN KEY (procedure_code)
        REFERENCES procedures(procedure_code)
        ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 5. Phenotype parameter groups (6 core groups seeded).
CREATE TABLE parameter_group (
    group_id INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    group_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (group_id),
    UNIQUE KEY uq_group_name (group_name)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

INSERT IGNORE INTO parameter_group (group_name) VALUES
    ('Weight'),
    ('Images'),
    ('Brain'),
    ('Haematology and immunophenotyping'),
    ('Behaviour'),
    ('Clinical chemistry and metabolism');

-- 6. Many-to-many parameter/group membership.
CREATE TABLE parameter_group_member (
    group_id INT NOT NULL,
    parameter_stable_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (group_id, parameter_stable_id),
    INDEX idx_groupmember_param (parameter_stable_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_groupmember_group FOREIGN KEY (group_id)
        REFERENCES parameter_group(group_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_groupmember_param FOREIGN KEY (parameter_stable_id)
        REFERENCES IMPC_parameters(parameter_stable_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 7. Core phenotype analysis rows (one row per test record; lacZ separated).
CREATE TABLE clean_data (
    result_id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    analysis_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    mgi_gene_id VARCHAR(32),
    mouse_gene_symbol VARCHAR(128),
    allele_symbol VARCHAR(255),
    strain_name VARCHAR(255),
    parameter_stable_id VARCHAR(64),
    parameter_name VARCHAR(255),
    p_value DOUBLE,
    mouse_life_stage VARCHAR(64),
    source_file VARCHAR(512),
    PRIMARY KEY (result_id),
    INDEX idx_analysis_id (analysis_id),
    INDEX idx_results_mgi (mgi_gene_id),
    INDEX idx_results_param (parameter_stable_id),
    INDEX idx_results_gene_symbol (mouse_gene_symbol),
    CONSTRAINT fk_result_mouse FOREIGN KEY (mgi_gene_id)
        REFERENCES mouse_gene(mgi_gene_id)
        ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_result_param FOREIGN KEY (parameter_stable_id)
        REFERENCES IMPC_parameters(parameter_stable_id)
        ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT chk_result_pvalue CHECK (p_value IS NULL OR (p_value >= 0 AND p_value <= 1))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 8. Per-analysis lacZ expression (11 tissue columns).
CREATE TABLE lacz_expression (
    result_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    lacz_blood VARCHAR(64),
    lacz_brain VARCHAR(64),
    lacz_colon VARCHAR(64),
    lacz_eye VARCHAR(64),
    lacz_heart VARCHAR(64),
    lacz_kidney VARCHAR(64),
    lacz_liver VARCHAR(64),
    lacz_lung VARCHAR(64),
    lacz_skeletal_muscle VARCHAR(64),
    lacz_skin VARCHAR(64),
    lacz_vascular_system VARCHAR(64),
    PRIMARY KEY (result_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_lacz_result FOREIGN KEY (result_id)
        REFERENCES clean_data(result_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 9. Bespoke task table + IMPC overlap flag + future HP metadata fields.
CREATE TABLE bespoke_task_table (
    bespoke_row_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    human_gene_symbol VARCHAR(128),
    human_ncbi_gene_id VARCHAR(64),
    mouse_gene_symbol VARCHAR(128),
    mgi_gene_id VARCHAR(32),
    human_gene_id BIGINT,
    hp_term_name VARCHAR(255),
    hp_description TEXT,
    in_impc_dataset TINYINT(1),
    PRIMARY KEY (bespoke_row_id),
    INDEX idx_bespoke_gene_pair (human_ncbi_gene_id, mgi_gene_id),
    INDEX idx_bespoke_mouse (mgi_gene_id),
    INDEX idx_bespoke_human (human_gene_id),
    INDEX idx_bespoke_overlap (in_impc_dataset),
    CONSTRAINT fk_bespoke_mouse FOREIGN KEY (mgi_gene_id)
        REFERENCES mouse_gene(mgi_gene_id)
        ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_bespoke_human FOREIGN KEY (human_gene_id)
        REFERENCES human_gene(human_gene_id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT chk_bespoke_in_impc CHECK (in_impc_dataset IS NULL OR in_impc_dataset IN (0, 1))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 10. Distinct Mammalian Phenotype terms.
CREATE TABLE mp_terms (
    mp_term_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    mp_term_name VARCHAR(255),
    PRIMARY KEY (mp_term_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 11. Bespoke-to-MP bridge table.
CREATE TABLE bespoke_task_mp_bridge (
    bespoke_row_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    mp_term_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (bespoke_row_id, mp_term_id),
    INDEX idx_bespoke_mp_term (mp_term_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_bespokemp_bespoke FOREIGN KEY (bespoke_row_id)
        REFERENCES bespoke_task_table(bespoke_row_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_bespokemp_term FOREIGN KEY (mp_term_id)
        REFERENCES mp_terms(mp_term_id)
        ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 12. Distinct Disease Ontology terms.
CREATE TABLE human_diseases (
    doid VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    disease_name VARCHAR(255),
    PRIMARY KEY (doid)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 13. Disease associations.
CREATE TABLE disease_clean (
    disease_row_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    human_gene_symbol VARCHAR(128),
    human_gene_name VARCHAR(255),
    hgnc_id VARCHAR(64),
    disease_name VARCHAR(255),
    doid VARCHAR(32),
    mouse_gene_symbol VARCHAR(128),
    mgi_gene_id VARCHAR(32),
    human_gene_id BIGINT,
    PRIMARY KEY (disease_row_id),
    INDEX idx_disease_hgnc_do (hgnc_id, doid),
    INDEX idx_disease_mouse (mgi_gene_id),
    INDEX idx_disease_term (doid),
    INDEX idx_disease_human (human_gene_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_disease_mouse FOREIGN KEY (mgi_gene_id)
        REFERENCES mouse_gene(mgi_gene_id)
        ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_disease_human FOREIGN KEY (human_gene_id)
        REFERENCES human_gene(human_gene_id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_disease_do FOREIGN KEY (doid)
        REFERENCES human_diseases(doid)
        ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 14. Expanded genotype bridge table.
CREATE TABLE genotype_bridge (
    disease_row_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    mouse_genotype_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (disease_row_id, mouse_genotype_id),
    INDEX idx_genotype_id (mouse_genotype_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_genotype_disease FOREIGN KEY (disease_row_id)
        REFERENCES disease_clean(disease_row_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 15. Ensembl gene table (supports future chromosomes).
CREATE TABLE chrom2_gene (
    ensembl_gene_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    gene_name VARCHAR(255),
    mgi_gene_id VARCHAR(32),
    mouse_gene_symbol VARCHAR(128),
    PRIMARY KEY (ensembl_gene_id),
    INDEX idx_chromgene_mgi (mgi_gene_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_chromgene_mgi FOREIGN KEY (mgi_gene_id)
        REFERENCES mouse_gene(mgi_gene_id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 16. Ensembl transcript table.
CREATE TABLE chrom2_transcript (
    ensembl_transcript_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    ensembl_gene_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (ensembl_transcript_id),
    INDEX idx_chromtranscript_gene (ensembl_gene_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_chromtranscript_gene FOREIGN KEY (ensembl_gene_id)
        REFERENCES chrom2_gene(ensembl_gene_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 17. Exon records.
CREATE TABLE chrom2 (
    chrom2_row_id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    ensembl_gene_id VARCHAR(32),
    ensembl_transcript_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    gene_name VARCHAR(255),
    ensembl_exon_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    exon_start BIGINT,
    exon_end BIGINT,
    exon_rank INT,
    PRIMARY KEY (chrom2_row_id),
    UNIQUE KEY uq_chrom_transcript_exon (ensembl_transcript_id, ensembl_exon_id),
    INDEX idx_chrom_gene_id (ensembl_gene_id),
    INDEX idx_chrom_exon_id (ensembl_exon_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_chrom2_transcript FOREIGN KEY (ensembl_transcript_id)
        REFERENCES chrom2_transcript(ensembl_transcript_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT chk_chrom_coordinates CHECK (exon_start IS NULL OR exon_end IS NULL OR exon_start <= exon_end),
    CONSTRAINT chk_chrom_rank CHECK (exon_rank IS NULL OR exon_rank >= 1)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 18. Optional group-specific external annotations.
CREATE TABLE parameter_group_external_data (
    external_record_id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    group_id INT NOT NULL,
    resource_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    external_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    term_or_label VARCHAR(255),
    notes TEXT,
    mgi_gene_id VARCHAR(32),
    PRIMARY KEY (external_record_id),
    INDEX idx_external_group_resource (group_id, resource_name),
    INDEX idx_external_external_id (external_id),
    INDEX idx_external_gene (mgi_gene_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_external_group FOREIGN KEY (group_id)
        REFERENCES parameter_group(group_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_external_mouse FOREIGN KEY (mgi_gene_id)
        REFERENCES mouse_gene(mgi_gene_id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

```

# Importing the data to the schema 

Connect via R

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(
  RMariaDB::MariaDB(),
  dbname   = "data_base_merged",
  host     = "127.0.0.1",
  port     = 3306,
  username = "root",
  password = rstudioapi::askForPassword("MySQL root password")
```

Importing process continued...

```{r}
setwd("../Raw Data/loading_txt_files/standardised_csvs/")
getwd()

csv_dir <- "."

# 2. Load the 8 CSVs present in standardised_csvs
bespoke_task_mp_bridge_df <- read_csv(file.path(csv_dir, "bespoke_task_mp_bridge.csv"), na = c("", "NA"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(trimws(.x), ""))) %>%
  distinct()

bespoke_task_table_df <- read_csv(file.path(csv_dir, "bespoke_task_table.csv"), na = c("", "NA"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(trimws(.x), "")))

disease_clean_df <- read_csv(file.path(csv_dir, "disease_clean.csv"), na = c("", "NA"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(trimws(.x), "")))

genotype_bridge_df <- read_csv(file.path(csv_dir, "genotype_bridge.csv"), na = c("", "NA"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(trimws(.x), ""))) %>%
  distinct()

impc_parameters_df <- read_csv(file.path(csv_dir, "IMPC_parameters.csv"), na = c("", "NA"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(trimws(.x), "")))

procedures_df <- read_csv(file.path(csv_dir, "procedures.csv"), na = c("", "NA"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(trimws(.x), "")))

mouse_merged_df <- read_csv(file.path(csv_dir, "mouse_merged.csv"), na = c("", "NA"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(trimws(.x), "")),
    result_id = if (!"result_id" %in% names(.)) row_number() else result_id
  )

chrom2_df <- read_csv(file.path(csv_dir, "chrom2.csv"), na = c("", "NA"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(trimws(.x), "")))

# 3. Split mouse_merged into clean_data and lacz_expression
lacz_cols <- c(
  "lacz_blood", "lacz_brain", "lacz_colon", "lacz_eye",
  "lacz_heart", "lacz_kidney", "lacz_liver", "lacz_lung",
  "lacz_skeletal_muscle", "lacz_skin", "lacz_vascular_system"
)

clean_data_df <- mouse_merged_df %>%
  select(any_of(c(
    "result_id", "analysis_id", "mgi_gene_id", "mouse_gene_symbol",
    "allele_symbol", "strain_name", "parameter_stable_id", "parameter_name",
    "p_value", "mouse_life_stage", "source_file"
  )))

lacz_expression_df <- mouse_merged_df %>%
  select(any_of(c("result_id", lacz_cols)))

# 4. Flag bespoke rows overlapping IMPC mgi_gene_id + add future HP columns if absent
impc_mgi_ids <- unique(na.omit(clean_data_df$mgi_gene_id))
bespoke_task_table_df <- bespoke_task_table_df %>%
  mutate(
    in_impc_dataset = as.integer(!is.na(mgi_gene_id) & mgi_gene_id %in% impc_mgi_ids),
    hp_term_name    = if (!"hp_term_name" %in% names(.)) NA_character_ else hp_term_name,
    hp_description  = if (!"hp_description" %in% names(.)) NA_character_ else hp_description
  )

# 5. Derive required parent/reference tables
mouse_gene_df <- bind_rows(
  clean_data_df %>% select(any_of(c("mgi_gene_id", "mouse_gene_symbol"))),
  bespoke_task_table_df %>% select(any_of(c("mgi_gene_id", "mouse_gene_symbol"))),
  disease_clean_df %>% select(any_of(c("mgi_gene_id", "mouse_gene_symbol")))
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mgi_gene_id)) %>%
  group_by(mgi_gene_id) %>%
  summarise(
    mouse_gene_symbol = dplyr::first(na.omit(mouse_gene_symbol)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

mp_terms_df <- bespoke_task_mp_bridge_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(mp_term_id)) %>%
  distinct(mp_term_id) %>%
  mutate(mp_term_name = NA_character_)

human_diseases_df <- disease_clean_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(doid)) %>%
  group_by(doid) %>%
  summarise(
    disease_name = dplyr::first(na.omit(disease_name)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

chrom2_gene_df <- chrom2_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(ensembl_gene_id)) %>%
  group_by(ensembl_gene_id) %>%
  summarise(
    gene_name = dplyr::first(na.omit(gene_name)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mgi_gene_id       = NA_character_,
    mouse_gene_symbol = NA_character_
  )

chrom2_transcript_df <- chrom2_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(ensembl_transcript_id), !is.na(ensembl_gene_id)) %>%
  distinct(ensembl_transcript_id, ensembl_gene_id)

# 6. Helper to append matching columns in chunks
write_to_db <- function(con, table_name, df, chunk_size = 50000) {
  db_cols <- dbListFields(con, table_name)
  df_sub  <- df %>% select(any_of(db_cols))
  
  n <- nrow(df_sub)
  if (n == 0) {
    message("0 rows for ", table_name, " -> skipped")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  chunks <- split(seq_len(n), ceiling(seq_len(n) / chunk_size))
  for (idx in chunks) {
    dbWriteTable(
      conn      = con,
      name      = table_name,
      value     = df_sub[idx, , drop = FALSE],
      append    = TRUE,
      overwrite = FALSE,
      row.names = FALSE
    )
  }
  message("Loaded ", n, " rows into ", table_name)
}
```

## Query 1

Gene-Level Overall Phenotype, LacZ Expression & Chromosome 2 Summary

Summarises each target gene into a single overview row

First we need to determine which 4 genes to use as the prompt suggests 4 genes for the collaborator

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

q_genes <- read_csv("../../group14_query_genes.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
names(q_genes)
print(q_genes)

# Pull non-missing gene symbol values (adjust column name if it differs)
gene_symbols <- q_genes %>%
  pull(1) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  unique()

gene_symbols # choose the ones displayed here
```

4 genes of interest = Rhbdl2, Scx, Muc5ac and Parpbp

Lets query now

```{sql connection=}

SELECT
  c.mouse_gene_symbol,
  c.mgi_gene_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.result_id) AS grouped_tests,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pg.group_id) AS groups_tested,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.p_value < 0.0001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS significant_hits,
  MIN(c.p_value) AS min_p_value,
  -LOG10(GREATEST(MIN(c.p_value), 1e-300)) AS neg_log10_min_p,
  COUNT(DISTINCT l.result_id) AS lacz_linked_records,
  MAX(b.in_impc_dataset) AS in_bespoke_impc_overlap,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c2.ensembl_exon_id) AS chrom2_exons
FROM data_base_merged.clean_data c
INNER JOIN data_base_merged.parameter_group_member pgm
  ON c.parameter_stable_id = pgm.parameter_stable_id
INNER JOIN data_base_merged.parameter_group pg
  ON pgm.group_id = pg.group_id
LEFT JOIN data_base_merged.lacz_expression l
  ON c.result_id = l.result_id
LEFT JOIN data_base_merged.bespoke_task_table b
  ON c.mgi_gene_id = b.mgi_gene_id
LEFT JOIN data_base_merged.chrom2_gene cg
  ON c.mgi_gene_id = cg.mgi_gene_id
LEFT JOIN data_base_merged.chrom2_transcript ct
  ON cg.ensembl_gene_id = ct.ensembl_gene_id
LEFT JOIN data_base_merged.chrom2 c2
  ON ct.ensembl_transcript_id = c2.ensembl_transcript_id
WHERE c.mouse_gene_symbol IN ('Rhbdl2', 'Scx', 'Muc5ac', 'Parpbp')
  AND c.p_value IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  c.mouse_gene_symbol,
  c.mgi_gene_id
ORDER BY
  significant_hits DESC,
  min_p_value ASC;
```

## Query 2

Gene and Parameter Group Summary

Aggregates test counts, significant hits, minimum p-value, negative log10 p-value, bespoke task overlap, and chromosome 2 exon counts per gene and parameter group.

```{sql connection=}

SELECT
  c.mouse_gene_symbol,
  c.mgi_gene_id,
  pg.group_name AS parameter_group,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.result_id) AS total_tests,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.p_value < 0.0001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS significant_hits,
  MIN(c.p_value) AS min_p_value,
  -LOG10(GREATEST(MIN(c.p_value), 1e-300)) AS neg_log10_min_p,
  MAX(b.in_impc_dataset) AS in_bespoke_impc_overlap,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c2.ensembl_exon_id) AS chrom2_exons
FROM data_base_merged.clean_data c
INNER JOIN data_base_merged.parameter_group_member pgm
  ON c.parameter_stable_id = pgm.parameter_stable_id
INNER JOIN data_base_merged.parameter_group pg
  ON pgm.group_id = pg.group_id
LEFT JOIN data_base_merged.bespoke_task_table b
  ON c.mgi_gene_id = b.mgi_gene_id
LEFT JOIN data_base_merged.chrom2_gene cg
  ON c.mgi_gene_id = cg.mgi_gene_id
LEFT JOIN data_base_merged.chrom2_transcript ct
  ON cg.ensembl_gene_id = ct.ensembl_gene_id
LEFT JOIN data_base_merged.chrom2 c2
  ON ct.ensembl_transcript_id = c2.ensembl_transcript_id
WHERE c.mouse_gene_symbol IN ('Rhbdl2', 'Scx', 'Muc5ac', 'Parpbp')
  AND c.p_value IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  c.mouse_gene_symbol,
  c.mgi_gene_id,
  pg.group_name
ORDER BY
  c.mouse_gene_symbol,
  min_p_value ASC;

```

## Query 3

Life stage and parameter group hit rate breakdown

Breaks down each target gene across life stage and parameter group with normalized hit_rate (significant_hits / total_tests) to compare signal density across groups and developmental stages.

```{sql connection=}
SELECT
  c.mouse_gene_symbol,
  c.mgi_gene_id,
  COALESCE(c.mouse_life_stage, 'Unspecified') AS life_stage,
  pg.group_name AS parameter_group,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.result_id) AS total_tests,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.p_value < 0.0001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS significant_hits,
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.p_value < 0.0001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.result_id),
    4
  ) AS hit_rate,
  MIN(c.p_value) AS min_p_value,
  -LOG10(GREATEST(MIN(c.p_value), 1e-300)) AS neg_log10_min_p
FROM data_base_merged.clean_data c
INNER JOIN data_base_merged.parameter_group_member pgm
  ON c.parameter_stable_id = pgm.parameter_stable_id
INNER JOIN data_base_merged.parameter_group pg
  ON pgm.group_id = pg.group_id
WHERE c.mouse_gene_symbol IN ('Rhbdl2', 'Scx', 'Muc5ac', 'Parpbp')
  AND c.p_value IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  c.mouse_gene_symbol,
  c.mgi_gene_id,
  life_stage,
  pg.group_name
ORDER BY
  c.mouse_gene_symbol,
  life_stage,
  hit_rate DESC,
  min_p_value ASC;
```

![](images/clipboard-3416621647.png)

## Query 4

Ranked IMPC 6-Group Phenotype, Human Disease, Bespoke MP, Tissue LacZ & Chromosome 2 Profile (Rhbdl2, Scx, Muc5ac, Parpbp)

```{sql connection=}

SELECT COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'data_base_merged'
  AND TABLE_NAME IN ('genotype_bridge', 'disease_clean', 'human_diseases', 'bespoke_task_table', 'bespoke_task_mp_bridge', 'mp_terms', 'lacz_expression')
ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION;


WITH target_genes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    c.mouse_gene_symbol,
    c.mgi_gene_id
  FROM data_base_merged.clean_data c
  WHERE c.mouse_gene_symbol IN ('Rhbdl2', 'Scx', 'Muc5ac', 'Parpbp')
    AND c.mgi_gene_id IS NOT NULL
),
disease_summary AS (
  SELECT
    tg.mgi_gene_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dc.disease_row_id) AS n_disease_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gb.mouse_genotype_id) AS n_bridged_genotypes,
    GROUP_CONCAT(
      DISTINCT CONCAT(dc.doid, ': ', COALESCE(hd.disease_name, dc.disease_name))
      ORDER BY dc.doid
      SEPARATOR '; '
    ) AS diseases
  FROM target_genes tg
  INNER JOIN data_base_merged.disease_clean dc
    ON tg.mgi_gene_id = dc.mgi_gene_id
  LEFT JOIN data_base_merged.human_diseases hd
    ON dc.doid = hd.doid
  LEFT JOIN data_base_merged.genotype_bridge gb
    ON dc.disease_row_id = gb.disease_row_id
  GROUP BY tg.mgi_gene_id
),
bespoke_summary AS (
  SELECT
    b.mgi_gene_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bespoke_row_id) AS n_bespoke_rows,
    MAX(b.in_impc_dataset) AS in_impc_dataset,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT b.hp_term_name ORDER BY b.hp_term_name SEPARATOR '; ') AS hp_terms,
    GROUP_CONCAT(
      DISTINCT CONCAT(bmp.mp_term_id, ' (', COALESCE(mt.mp_term_name, 'unnamed'), ')')
      ORDER BY bmp.mp_term_id
      SEPARATOR '; '
    ) AS bespoke_mp_terms
  FROM data_base_merged.bespoke_task_table b
  LEFT JOIN data_base_merged.bespoke_task_mp_bridge bmp
    ON b.bespoke_row_id = bmp.bespoke_row_id
  LEFT JOIN data_base_merged.mp_terms mt
    ON bmp.mp_term_id = mt.mp_term_id
  GROUP BY b.mgi_gene_id
),
lacz_summary AS (
  SELECT
    c.mgi_gene_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.result_id) AS lacz_result_rows,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.lacz_brain IS NOT NULL AND l.lacz_brain != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lacz_brain_n,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.lacz_heart IS NOT NULL AND l.lacz_heart != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lacz_heart_n,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.lacz_liver IS NOT NULL AND l.lacz_liver != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lacz_liver_n,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.lacz_lung IS NOT NULL AND l.lacz_lung != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lacz_lung_n,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.lacz_kidney IS NOT NULL AND l.lacz_kidney != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lacz_kidney_n,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.lacz_skin IS NOT NULL AND l.lacz_skin != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lacz_skin_n,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.lacz_skeletal_muscle IS NOT NULL AND l.lacz_skeletal_muscle != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lacz_muscle_n,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.lacz_eye IS NOT NULL AND l.lacz_eye != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lacz_eye_n,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.lacz_colon IS NOT NULL AND l.lacz_colon != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lacz_colon_n,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.lacz_blood IS NOT NULL AND l.lacz_blood != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lacz_blood_n,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.lacz_vascular_system IS NOT NULL AND l.lacz_vascular_system != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lacz_vascular_n
  FROM data_base_merged.clean_data c
  INNER JOIN data_base_merged.lacz_expression l
    ON c.result_id = l.result_id
  WHERE c.mouse_gene_symbol IN ('Rhbdl2', 'Scx', 'Muc5ac', 'Parpbp')
  GROUP BY c.mgi_gene_id
),
chrom2_summary AS (
  SELECT
    cg.mgi_gene_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ct.ensembl_transcript_id) AS chrom2_transcripts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c2.ensembl_exon_id) AS chrom2_exons
  FROM data_base_merged.chrom2_gene cg
  LEFT JOIN data_base_merged.chrom2_transcript ct
    ON cg.ensembl_gene_id = ct.ensembl_gene_id
  LEFT JOIN data_base_merged.chrom2 c2
    ON ct.ensembl_transcript_id = c2.ensembl_transcript_id
  GROUP BY cg.mgi_gene_id
),
phenotype_summary AS (
  SELECT
    c.mgi_gene_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.result_id) AS grouped_tests,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pg.group_id) AS groups_tested,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.p_value < 0.0001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sig_hits,
    ROUND(
      SUM(CASE WHEN c.p_value < 0.0001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.result_id), 0),
      4
    ) AS hit_rate,
    MIN(c.p_value) AS min_p_value,
    ROUND(-LOG10(GREATEST(MIN(c.p_value), 1e-300)), 2) AS neg_log10_min_p
  FROM data_base_merged.clean_data c
  INNER JOIN data_base_merged.parameter_group_member pgm
    ON c.parameter_stable_id = pgm.parameter_stable_id
  INNER JOIN data_base_merged.parameter_group pg
    ON pgm.group_id = pg.group_id
  WHERE c.p_value IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.mgi_gene_id
)
SELECT
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(ps.sig_hits, 0) DESC, ps.min_p_value ASC) AS cohort_rank,
  tg.mouse_gene_symbol,
  tg.mgi_gene_id,
  COALESCE(ps.grouped_tests, 0) AS grouped_tests,
  COALESCE(ps.groups_tested, 0) AS groups_tested,
  COALESCE(ps.sig_hits, 0) AS sig_hits,
  COALESCE(ps.hit_rate, 0) AS hit_rate,
  ps.min_p_value,
  ps.neg_log10_min_p,
  COALESCE(ds.n_disease_rows, 0) AS n_disease_rows,
  COALESCE(ds.n_bridged_genotypes, 0) AS n_bridged_genotypes,
  ds.diseases,
  COALESCE(bs.n_bespoke_rows, 0) AS n_bespoke_rows,
  COALESCE(bs.in_impc_dataset, 0) AS in_impc_dataset,
  bs.hp_terms,
  bs.bespoke_mp_terms,
  COALESCE(ls.lacz_result_rows, 0) AS lacz_result_rows,
  COALESCE(ls.lacz_brain_n, 0) AS lacz_brain_n,
  COALESCE(ls.lacz_heart_n, 0) AS lacz_heart_n,
  COALESCE(ls.lacz_liver_n, 0) AS lacz_liver_n,
  COALESCE(ls.lacz_lung_n, 0) AS lacz_lung_n,
  COALESCE(ls.lacz_kidney_n, 0) AS lacz_kidney_n,
  COALESCE(ls.lacz_skin_n, 0) AS lacz_skin_n,
  COALESCE(ls.lacz_muscle_n, 0) AS lacz_muscle_n,
  COALESCE(ls.lacz_eye_n, 0) AS lacz_eye_n,
  COALESCE(ls.lacz_colon_n, 0) AS lacz_colon_n,
  COALESCE(ls.lacz_blood_n, 0) AS lacz_blood_n,
  COALESCE(ls.lacz_vascular_n, 0) AS lacz_vascular_n,
  COALESCE(c2s.chrom2_transcripts, 0) AS chrom2_transcripts,
  COALESCE(c2s.chrom2_exons, 0) AS chrom2_exons
FROM target_genes tg
LEFT JOIN phenotype_summary ps
  ON tg.mgi_gene_id = ps.mgi_gene_id
LEFT JOIN disease_summary ds
  ON tg.mgi_gene_id = ds.mgi_gene_id
LEFT JOIN bespoke_summary bs
  ON tg.mgi_gene_id = bs.mgi_gene_id
LEFT JOIN lacz_summary ls
  ON tg.mgi_gene_id = ls.mgi_gene_id
LEFT JOIN chrom2_summary c2s
  ON tg.mgi_gene_id = c2s.mgi_gene_id
ORDER BY cohort_rank, tg.mouse_gene_symbol;

```

## Query 5

Cohort-wide top-genes query (top 5 per parameter group across your 6 groups) that pre-aggregates the disease links (disease_clean, human_diseases, genotype_bridge) and bespoke task / Mammalian Phenotype links (bespoke_task_table, bespoke_task_mp_bridge, mp_terms

```{sql connection=}
WITH gene_group_stats AS (
  SELECT
    pg.group_id,
    pg.group_name AS parameter_group,
    c.mouse_gene_symbol,
    c.mgi_gene_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.result_id) AS total_tests,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.p_value < 0.0001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sig_hits,
    ROUND(
      SUM(CASE WHEN c.p_value < 0.0001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.result_id), 0),
      4
    ) AS hit_rate,
    MIN(c.p_value) AS min_p_value,
    ROUND(-LOG10(GREATEST(MIN(c.p_value), 1e-300)), 2) AS neg_log10_min_p
  FROM data_base_merged.clean_data c
  INNER JOIN data_base_merged.parameter_group_member pgm
    ON c.parameter_stable_id = pgm.parameter_stable_id
  INNER JOIN data_base_merged.parameter_group pg
    ON pgm.group_id = pg.group_id
  WHERE c.mouse_gene_symbol IS NOT NULL
    AND c.mgi_gene_id IS NOT NULL
    AND c.p_value IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    pg.group_id,
    pg.group_name,
    c.mouse_gene_symbol,
    c.mgi_gene_id
),
top5_by_group AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY group_id
      ORDER BY sig_hits DESC, min_p_value ASC, mouse_gene_symbol ASC
    ) AS group_gene_rank
  FROM gene_group_stats
),
top_genes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    mgi_gene_id
  FROM top5_by_group
  WHERE group_gene_rank <= 5
),
disease_agg AS (
  SELECT
    dc.mgi_gene_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dc.doid) AS n_diseases,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gb.mouse_genotype_id) AS n_bridged_genotypes,
    GROUP_CONCAT(
      DISTINCT CONCAT(dc.doid, ': ', COALESCE(hd.disease_name, dc.disease_name))
      ORDER BY dc.doid
      SEPARATOR '; '
    ) AS diseases
  FROM top_genes tg
  INNER JOIN data_base_merged.disease_clean dc
    ON tg.mgi_gene_id = dc.mgi_gene_id
  LEFT JOIN data_base_merged.human_diseases hd
    ON dc.doid = hd.doid
  LEFT JOIN data_base_merged.genotype_bridge gb
    ON dc.disease_row_id = gb.disease_row_id
  GROUP BY dc.mgi_gene_id
),
bespoke_agg AS (
  SELECT
    b.mgi_gene_id,
    MAX(COALESCE(b.in_impc_dataset, 0)) AS in_impc_dataset,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bmp.mp_term_id) AS n_bespoke_mp_terms,
    GROUP_CONCAT(
      DISTINCT CONCAT(bmp.mp_term_id, ' (', COALESCE(mt.mp_term_name, 'unmapped'), ')')
      ORDER BY bmp.mp_term_id
      SEPARATOR '; '
    ) AS bespoke_mp_terms
  FROM top_genes tg
  INNER JOIN data_base_merged.bespoke_task_table b
    ON tg.mgi_gene_id = b.mgi_gene_id
  LEFT JOIN data_base_merged.bespoke_task_mp_bridge bmp
    ON b.bespoke_row_id = bmp.bespoke_row_id
  LEFT JOIN data_base_merged.mp_terms mt
    ON bmp.mp_term_id = mt.mp_term_id
  GROUP BY b.mgi_gene_id
)
SELECT
  t.parameter_group,
  t.group_gene_rank,
  t.mouse_gene_symbol,
  t.mgi_gene_id,
  t.total_tests,
  t.sig_hits,
  t.hit_rate,
  t.min_p_value,
  t.neg_log10_min_p,
  COALESCE(d.n_diseases, 0) AS n_diseases,
  COALESCE(d.n_bridged_genotypes, 0) AS n_bridged_genotypes,
  d.diseases,
  COALESCE(b.in_impc_dataset, 0) AS in_impc_dataset,
  COALESCE(b.n_bespoke_mp_terms, 0) AS n_bespoke_mp_terms,
  b.bespoke_mp_terms
FROM top5_by_group t
LEFT JOIN disease_agg d
  ON t.mgi_gene_id = d.mgi_gene_id
LEFT JOIN bespoke_agg b
  ON t.mgi_gene_id = b.mgi_gene_id
WHERE t.group_gene_rank <= 5
ORDER BY t.parameter_group, t.group_gene_rank;

```

## Query 6

Chromosome 2 Transcript & Exon Lookup for Four Chromosome 2 Genes

First pick 4 genes that are evident in chromosome 2

```{sql connection=}
SELECT * FROM data_base_merged.chrom2_gene LIMIT 5;
SELECT * FROM data_base_merged.chrom2_transcript LIMIT 5;
SELECT * FROM data_base_merged.chrom2 LIMIT 5;
```

Query our chosen genes - Gpr107 Lhx2 Cdh4 Ckmt1

```{sql connection=}
WITH target_chr2_genes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    cg.gene_name,
    cg.ensembl_gene_id
  FROM data_base_merged.chrom2_gene cg
  WHERE cg.gene_name IN ('Gpr107', 'Lhx2', 'Cdh4', 'Ckmt1')
),
chrom2_chain AS (
  SELECT
    tg.gene_name,
    tg.ensembl_gene_id,
    ct.ensembl_transcript_id,
    c2.ensembl_exon_id
  FROM target_chr2_genes tg
  LEFT JOIN data_base_merged.chrom2_transcript ct
    ON tg.ensembl_gene_id = ct.ensembl_gene_id
  LEFT JOIN data_base_merged.chrom2 c2
    ON ct.ensembl_transcript_id = c2.ensembl_transcript_id
)
SELECT
  gene_name,
  ensembl_gene_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ensembl_transcript_id) AS chrom2_transcripts,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ensembl_exon_id) AS chrom2_exons,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ensembl_transcript_id ORDER BY ensembl_transcript_id SEPARATOR ', ') AS transcript_ids,
  SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT ensembl_exon_id)) OVER () AS total_selected_chr2_exons
FROM chrom2_chain
GROUP BY
  gene_name,
  ensembl_gene_id
ORDER BY
  chrom2_exons DESC,
  gene_name ASC;

```
